title: Structured slot progress in status, the diff base for every case selection, a narrow dollar rule, a neutral generic explorer name

tasks.grade_reason: the status schema every run lead reads and the task QA case selection
tasks.objective: Backlog topic qa-reach-followups (docs/plans/backlog.md), three items in scripts/factory-pipeline.py and tests/pipeline.test.sh. (1) `status --json` carries the test slot progress (from plan qa-reach: each slot holder's last check, result, counts and the age of its last update) only in the stderr 'Slots:' text line, because docs/schemas/pipeline-status.schema.json has no slots field. Add a structured `slots` field to the status JSON and to the schema (one entry per held slot: slot number, pid, alive, checkout, started, and the progress fields or null when there is none yet), keep the text output as it is, and keep 'the user decides, the run never stops it'. (2) `affected_selection` calls `tests/affected.py cases` without `--base`, so the dispatch and QA case lists get the per-symbol reach only when its file list equals the default-base changed set: pass the base it diffs against. (3) Any scripts/assetgen/assetgen.py change selects every case group of tests/pipeline.test.sh: the import closure of the changed file reaches files that no pipeline case-map group maps (scripts/checks/domains/assetgen.py, scripts/factory-cmd.py, tests/fixtures/assetgen/*.py), and an unmapped reached file gives ALL. Find with evidence (tests/affected.py cases on a one-function assetgen.py change) which pipeline groups really run those files and map them, so such a change selects only those groups; leave a file on ALL when unsure. Report the group count before and after. Cases in tests/pipeline.test.sh (status --json slots from a fake slot directory, the schema validates; affected_selection passes the base). Changelog fragment changelog.d/qa-reach-followups-pipeline.md. Update docs/pipeline-cli.md only where it describes the status output. CI runs on Linux: no test may depend on host tools of this Windows machine. The machine is short on memory: run one test command at a time with -j 1; stop your own test run before you report.
acceptance: status --json has a schema-valid slots field with each holder's progress
affected_selection passes the diff base to affected.py cases

tasks.grade_reason: one regex branch of the style lock external path rule
tasks.objective: Backlog topic external-path-dollar (docs/plans/backlog.md). The `$NAME` branch of `EXTERNAL_URI_OR_ENV` in scripts/assetgen/stylelock.py refuses a dollar sign followed by a letter even with no path separator after it, so prose such as 'priced in $USD' in an `origin` or `rights_note` is refused. Narrow the branch to `$NAME` followed by a path separator (slash or backslash) or `${NAME}` (braced form, with or without a separator), keep `file:` and `%NAME%` as they are. Cases in tests/assetgen.test.sh: 'priced in $USD' passes; '$HOME/x', '$HOME\\x' and '${HOME}' are still refused. Changelog fragment changelog.d/external-path-dollar.md (### Fixed). acceptance: prose with a dollar word passes and $NAME paths and ${NAME} are still refused
